reason: I already pay a VA to do this and I make under $5k a month, so $147 on a card for software with zero published results is a big bet. 'Payments are final' after a 3-day trial reads like a trap to me.
objection: Three days is not enough time to see if this books a single call, and the moment it bills on day 4 I can't get my money back. No customer results, only 7 founding seats taken, so I'd be the guinea pig.
would_change_my_mind: A real refund window after the first charge (say 14 to 30 days), or a longer trial, plus a few named customers showing actual replies and booked calls.
